newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: PHILIPS SHARES LEAP ON Q1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPS SHARES LEAP ON Q1 RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Philips Electronics NV surged 6.90 guilders, 7.5 percent, to 98.00 guilders at the opening on Wednesday, after the electronics giant posted strong first quarter earnings.

Philips said first net profits surged to 887 million guilders, up from 692 million a year-earlier. Net profit from ordinary operations rose to 460 million guilders from 377 million. It added it was on track to achieve its profit targets.
"The results looked very good indeed," one dealer said.
The Amsterdam bourse was up around two percent.
